recommendation.reason: Retain separate provider installation and ownership boundaries; the measured alternatives are incomparable, not a fabricated Pareto winner.

effectPatch.rationale: Historical donor/research patch only. Official unpatched rc.108 passes the selected API and actual published producer consumer; omit patchedDependencies from the proposed manifest. The negative control confirms the donor-only private Param declaration is absent.

workspaceRoot.rationale: T2/T3 give the already independent kernel its own package directory; this relocates paths and development metadata without changing public coordinates or semantic dependency mechanisms.

privateWorkspaces.ownership: Stages the core package's shared CLI; no second authored parser or loader.

privateWorkspaces.actionYaml:
name: ts-release
description: Execute one authored release application against its durable journal.
author: mannyc2
inputs:
  application:
    description: Workspace-contained ESM application exporting createApplication.
    required: true
  input:
    description: JSON input passed to createApplication.
    required: false
    default: '{}'
outputs:
  plan-id:
    description: Identity of the application's exact publication plan.
  journal-revision:
    description: Durable journal revision reported by the application.
runs:
  using: node24
  main: dist/launcher.cjs
branding:
  icon: package
  color: blue

delivery.sourceCompilation: TypeScript ESM plus declarations from these physical sources, with explicit exports. Bundle only CLI/Action delivery applications; do not ship handwritten shadow dist.
delivery.scriptsAndConfigTemplates: Per-layout exact tsconfig templates are in alternatives[].configs; root manifest contains exact commands.

scriptContracts.task: Run TypeScript with each selected public package tsconfig.build.json in core-first package-DAG order, then compile apps/self-release. No source path aliases.
Build first, run strict root noEmit check, then verify actual emitted exports/import/package graphs against the selected contract.
Stage the core-owned CLI and bundle apps/action/src/launcher.ts as node24 CommonJS apps/action/dist/launcher.cjs; validate dynamic application loading in fresh installed consumers.

delivery.scriptsAndConfigStatus: Exact configuration templates and script paths/contracts are proposed. Script implementations remain wave work and have no invented line totals.
delivery.cliRuntimeSelection: One shared loader runs the fully provided application Effect inside Scope. Application authors select/provide their host layers; CLI does not automatically import platform facades.

measuredEvidence.relation: Smaller identical real machine/provider/host fixture across T1/T2/T3. Its measured installed/runtime/declaration graphs are not the proposed full production graph or its added semver/sigstore/effect-build dependencies.

invariants: No provider imports another provider or a concrete host module.
Neutral root entry, Bundle, Http and Git do not reach Node, Bun or Apple host implementations.
BundleCodec and BundleFinalize import private ArtifactModel, never the public Bundle facade.
GitCatalog.nativeHost is projected as makeGitCatalogHost only on node/bun entries; git remains provider-neutral.
Node never reaches Bun or bun:sqlite. Bun shares common hosts through direct imports, never through the Node facade.
Exports are explicit types/import conditions without wildcard or private-module access.
Provider package dependencies use the exact core cohort; Effect is one aligned required peer. Optional platform/Apple peers are reached only through explicit entry points.
Default shipped stores are SQLite and Git. S3 model remains research; no AWS SDK dependency is introduced.
Production source and full package graphs remain proposed. Measured topology receipts qualified a smaller common fixture, not these full manifests.

required: Fresh emitted full-product packs on admitted runtimes
Root/bundle/http/git import with every optional peer absent
Node import without platform-bun or effect-build-apple
Bun import without platform-node or effect-build-apple
Clear missing-peer error only when the corresponding entry is explicitly selected
Every provider fresh install without siblings
CLI and node24 Action distribution plus complete self-release rehearsal
Fresh registry coordinate and exact cohort recheck
